The site is NorthSea Grid — Dogger Bank Sector B Offshore Wind Telemetry & Alert Log, a realtime-telemetry-dashboard web application for NorthSea Grid Dogger Bank Sector B offshore wind telemetry and alert rule log.

Owner brief: "NorthSea Grid monitors offshore wind generation and battery storage across Dogger Bank Sector B and needs an operations telemetry console with a persisted alert-rule editor. Let duty engineers inspect turbine KPIs and time-window readings, submit a thermal alert threshold rule with incident notes, and verify that the saved rule persists on the server after a page reload."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-34/reference.jpg).

Art direction: NorthSea Grid — Dogger Bank Sector B Offshore Wind Telemetry & Alert Log: the page for NorthSea Grid Dogger Bank Sector B offshore wind telemetry and alert rule log, in a dark, low-glare palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #121316 (ns-bg), #1c1e24 (ns-surface), #252830 (ns-card), #323640 (ns-border), #10b981 (ns-emerald), #f59e0b (ns-amber), #f4f4f5 (ns-text), #a1a1aa (ns-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 10px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--ns-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a telemetry chart that hides the numerical value or alert state it reports; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of NorthSea Grid — Dogger Bank Sector B Offshore Wind Telemetry & Alert Log as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Turbine unit", "Duty engineer", "Warning threshold (°C)", "Critical threshold (°C)", "Incident annotation").

User journey context: Inspect Dogger Bank Sector B generation KPIs, 16-turbine status cells, and gearbox temperature readings. Configure a thermal alert rule with turbine unit, duty engineer, warning and critical thresholds, and incident note.
